title: Coral Reefs
definition: Coral reefs are diverse underwater ecosystems built by carbonate structures secreted by colonial marine invertebrates known as **polyps**, forming symbiotic relationships with microscopic algae called **zooxanthellae**.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims (geographical distribution, environmental degradation, bleaching, biological interactions) and Mains GS-3 (biodiversity loss, climate change impacts, coastal ecosystem management).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, physiological mechanisms, and ecological requirements of Coral Reefs.
Evaluate spatial distribution, global coral hotspots, and institutional frameworks in India.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
